summary: T12 mutation coverage is correct: moves atomically emit source-removal and target-addition in one transaction, all supported mutation paths record exactly one change, imported writes are rejected, and no duplicates occur. All 60 tests pass.
important_context: DAV delete path (http.rs:953-998) stamps resource_name post-commit with let _ =; a concurrent sync-collection in that narrow window could see NULL resource_name. T11 concern, not T12.
